text: Translating the fixed monitoring into Marcus's and Ananya's actual on-call day.
A business-outcome alert now pages on-call with a specific signal, which gets triaged against the right dashboard and escalated to Lin Chao's team if the cause is checkout-api's own code.
A synthetic canary runs an end-to-end checkout every few minutes, independent of real traffic -- so a problem gets caught even during a quiet hour.
Two real gaps remain, named honestly: Haverbrook Tickets runs in one AWS region with no failover yet, and the rest of the alert fleet hasn't been audited for this same blind spot.
Next: writing the real incident postmortem and runbook.
